subject: Soluna Health — Kickoff & owner assignments
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Soluna Health — Post-sign kickoff & owners

Team —

Quick wrap from legal/pursuits: Soluna signed the SOW this morning (attached: Soluna_SOW_signed_v3.pdf). High-level deal context below, and a short list of asks so we can get the kickoff on the calendar.

Deal snapshot
- Account: Soluna Health (payer/proprietary analytics team)
- ARR: $420k first year (reserved capacity + hosted API mix)
- Primary use-case: inference for clinical triage scoring + embeddings for internal search
- Compliance: customer requested VPC option + SOC2 evidence (they flagged audit window in Q1)
- Target go-live: 2027-01-18 (customer expects pilot before then)

Acceptance criteria (customer):
1) Private endpoint reachable from their AWS VPC (IP allowlist + KMS integration validated)
2) Integration tests demonstrating sub-200ms p50 latency for a 512-token prompt
3) Embedding index ingestion of 5M vectors with sampling validations

Immediate asks
- Confirm CS owner who will be primary PM/PO for the engagement (need a single point of contact)
- Technical owner for pre-kickoff (networking/KMS/VPC)
- Draft kickoff window: week of 2027-01-03 (customer available Jan 4–6 mornings PT)

Risks/notes for CS
- Customer requires data residency logs and at-rest encryption proof (refer to SOC2 artifacts)
- There's a clause for a 30-day operational SLA ramp in the SOW; we should flag any quota constraints now

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attach: Soluna_SOW_signed_v3.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Soluna Health — Kickoff & owner assignments

Thanks Ben — congrats on the close. Short internal note below with proposed owners and next steps.

Proposed owners (subject to capacity)
- Primary PM / Engagement Lead: Marcus Lin (CS) — will drive kickoff, runbook, acceptance tracking
- Technical Implementation Lead: Karthik Iyer — networking, VPC, KMS, and pre-kick technical validation
- Escalation / Executive Sponsor (internal): Hannah Schmitt — for billing/SLA exceptions and timeline escalations

Proposed immediate milestones
1) Pre-kick tech sync (30–45m) to scope VPC requirements and certificate exchange — target Jan 4 or Dec 30 (customer said mornings PT)
2) Delivery of onboarding checklist and runbook to customer 48h after tech sync (we will use onboarding_checklist_draft.xlsx as a starting point)
3) Integration test plan (latency/ingestion) by Jan 10

Open questions for Ben/customer to confirm
- Which AWS account / VPC will they use? Need VPC ID + contact for network ops
- Do they require HSM-backed KMS or are standard KMS keys OK?
- Any regulatory datapoints beyond SOC2 (e.g., HIPAA Business Associate Addendum)

Marcus/Karthik — can you confirm availability for Jan 4 AM PT for the pre-kick tech sync? If not, please propose alternate windows in the first week of Jan.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Soluna Health — Kickoff & owner assignments

Hannah — I can take the PM lead for this engagement. Confirming availability: Jan 4 09:30–11:00 PT looks good on my calendar for the pre-kick. I can also block a 60m kickoff on Jan 5 if the customer prefers a live session after the tech sync.

Technical notes / risks
- VPC setup: We will need a customer-side network contact to coordinate peering/allowlists. If they want Private deployment (customer asked about "VPC option"), that adds ~3 business days for network validation + cert rotation testing — factor this into the Jan 18 go-live target.
- KMS: we support CMKs and HSM-managed keys; if they require HSM, we should confirm key provisioning lead time with Infra (I’ll flag through the ticketing queue).
- SOC2 artifacts: Ben — please attach the SOC2 report link or point me to the docs in the Drive. Customer flagged an audit window in Q1; we should surface the actual evidence now.

Attached a quick draft onboarding checklist (onboarding_checklist_draft.xlsx) — I'll iterate with Karthik and send the version to the customer after the tech sync.

Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Attach: onboarding_checklist_draft.xlsx
